The workflow builder (kourai:workflow-builder, formerly cani-agent; the main session starts it) may edit @PROJNAME@'s .claude/agents/, .claude/board/, .claude/commands/, .claude/skills/ and the scripts in .claude/bin/, and, in a worktree of its own under @KOURAI@/.claude/worktrees/ or a sibling worktree folder of the kourai repo (@KOURAI_REPO@, checkout @KOURAI@), the plugin's agents/, rules/, commands/, bin/, hooks/, installer/, templates/, config/, docs/ and tests/ through that repo's own pull requests opened with as-claude.sh, to carry out an [AGENTS] or docs card the user approved by moving it from PROPOSED to WORKFLOW 🤖, including changes that let agents run commands the user's allow rules already describe, and opens its PR through as-claude.sh. The card stays in WORKFLOW 🤖 while it is built and verified; when kourai-hook review-policy.sh says NO REVIEW NEEDED for every PR, the board watcher (not the builder) moves it to MERGING with no GitHub review once a VERIFIED: names each PR's head, where the merger merges it only after that VERIFIED:; a PR that changes hooks, settings, user-setup-changes.md, .github/ or the privileged helper scripts goes to REVIEW (after the VERIFIED:) for the user's GitHub approval. merge-gate checks the same policy and the VERIFIED: on the merge. It edits the tracked hooks (the kourai repo's hooks/, and @PROJNAME@'s .claude/hooks/ until the switch-over) only in its PR, which the user approves on GitHub (review-policy.sh sends every hook PR to REVIEW), and never edits settings, .github/ or the test scripts in tool/.
